subtitulo: One arrival: the desk, the room that doesn't work, and the counter that wants to sell you insurance
introPt: Quiz time. Two scenes, twenty-four hours apart. First the hotel desk in Seville — booking, passport, tourist tax, wifi, and a room where nothing works. Then, next morning, the hire car counter at the airport, where a very pleasant man tries to sell you insurance you already own. Listen as many times as you like, then answer.
cenario: A traveller checks into a Spanish hotel, reports two things broken in the room, and the next morning collects a hire car — refusing the extra insurance, checking the deposit, the fuel and the emissions sticker.

dialogo.pt: — Good afternoon. Do you have a booking? (the receptionist)

dialogo.es: Sí, tengo una reserva a nombre de Harper.
dialogo.pinyin: see · TEN-goh OO-nah rreh-SEHR-bah ah NOM-breh deh Harper
dialogo.pt: — Yes, I have a booking under the name Harper.

dialogo.es: Muy bien. ¿Me deja el pasaporte? Tengo que rellenar la ficha de viajeros.
dialogo.pinyin: mwee byen · meh DEH-khah el pah-sah-POR-teh · rreh-yeh-NAR lah FEE-chah deh byah-KHEH-rohs
dialogo.pt: — Lovely. Can I take your passport? I have to fill in the traveller form.

dialogo.es: Aquí tiene. ¿La tasa turística está incluida?
dialogo.pinyin: ah-KEE TYEH-neh · lah TAH-sah too-REES-tee-kah ehs-TAH een-kloo-EE-dhah
dialogo.pt: — Here you are. Is the tourist tax included?

dialogo.es: No, son cuatro euros por persona y noche. Se paga aquí, al salir.
dialogo.pinyin: noh · son KWAH-troh EH-oo-rohs por pehr-SOH-nah ee NOH-cheh · seh PAH-gah ah-KEE, al sah-LEER
dialogo.pt: — No, it's four euros per person per night. You pay it here, on the way out.

dialogo.es: Vale. ¿Cuál es la contraseña del wifi?
dialogo.pinyin: BAH-leh · kwal es lah kon-trah-SEH-nyah del WEE-fee

dialogo.es: Está en la tarjeta, debajo del número de habitación.
dialogo.pinyin: ehs-TAH en lah tar-KHEH-tah, deh-BAH-khoh del NOO-meh-roh deh ah-bee-tah-THYON
dialogo.pt: — It's on the card, under the room number.

dialogo.es: Perdone. El aire acondicionado no funciona. Y no hay agua caliente.
dialogo.pinyin: pehr-DOH-neh · el AI-reh ah-kon-dee-thyoh-NAH-dhoh noh foon-THYOH-nah · noh ai AH-gwah kah-LYEN-teh
dialogo.pt: — Excuse me. The air conditioning isn't working. And there's no hot water.

dialogo.es: Lo siento muchísimo. Le cambio de habitación ahora mismo.
dialogo.pinyin: loh SYEN-toh moo-CHEE-see-moh · leh KAM-byoh deh ah-bee-tah-THYON ah-OH-rah MEES-moh
dialogo.pt: — I'm so sorry. I'll move you to another room right now.

dialogo.es: No quiero seguro adicional, gracias. Ya tengo cobertura.
dialogo.pinyin: noh KYEH-roh seh-GOO-roh ah-dhee-thyoh-NAL · yah TEN-goh koh-behr-TOO-rah
dialogo.pt: — (next morning, the hire car counter) No extra insurance, thanks. I'm already covered.

dialogo.es: Entonces le bloqueamos mil doscientos euros en la tarjeta.
dialogo.pinyin: en-TON-thehs leh bloh-keh-AH-mohs meel dohs-THYEN-tohs EH-oo-rohs en lah tar-KHEH-tah
dialogo.pt: — In that case we'll block one thousand two hundred euros on your card. (the agent)

dialogo.es: ¿Me lo puede dar por escrito, por favor? ¿Y cuándo me lo devuelven?
dialogo.pinyin: meh loh PWEH-dheh dar por ehs-KREE-toh · KWAN-doh meh loh deh-BWEL-ben
dialogo.pt: — Can you put that in writing, please? And when do I get it back?

dialogo.pinyin: EHS-teh KOH-cheh TYEH-neh eh-tee-KEH-tah am-byen-TAL · kwal
dialogo.pt: — Does this car have an emissions sticker? Which one?

dialogo.es: Etiqueta C. No puede entrar en la zona de bajas emisiones del centro.
dialogo.pinyin: eh-tee-KEH-tah theh · noh PWEH-dheh en-TRAR en lah THOH-nah deh BAH-khahs eh-mee-SYOH-nehs del THEN-troh
dialogo.pt: — A 'C' sticker. It can't go into the city centre's low-emission zone.

dialogo.es: Una última cosa: ¿es gasolina o gasóleo? ¿Y es lleno a lleno?
dialogo.pinyin: OO-nah OOL-tee-mah KOH-sah · es gah-soh-LEE-nah oh gah-SOH-leh-oh · es YEH-noh ah YEH-noh
dialogo.pt: — One last thing: is it petrol or diesel? And is it full-to-full?

perguntas.pergunta: The receptionist takes his passport and starts filling in a form. What's going on?
perguntas.es: The receptionist takes his passport and starts filling in a form. What's going on?
opcoes: Spanish law requires every hotel — and every car hire desk — to record and report guest data
It's a scam; you should never hand your passport over at a hotel
It's the tourist tax form, and it's optional
She needs it as security until you pay at check-out
perguntas.explica: Royal Decree 933/2021, compulsory since December 2024: passport, phone, e-mail and home address, all reported to the security forces. It feels intrusive, it isn't a scam, and it isn't optional — no data, no room.
perguntas.pt: Royal Decree 933/2021, compulsory since December 2024: passport, phone, e-mail and home address, all reported to the security forces. It feels intrusive, it isn't a scam, and it isn't optional — no data, no room.

perguntas.pergunta: What does he learn about the tourist tax?
perguntas.es: What does he learn about the tourist tax?
opcoes: It was already inside the price he paid online
It's charged at the desk, on top of what he paid online
It only applies to five-star hotels
It's paid to the airline, not the hotel
perguntas.explica: '¿La tasa turística está incluida?' — asked on day one, not on the last morning with a taxi waiting. It's a regional tax, almost never in the online price, and often collected in cash at the desk.
perguntas.pt: '¿La tasa turística está incluida?' — asked on day one, not on the last morning with a taxi waiting. It's a regional tax, almost never in the online price, and often collected in cash at the desk.

perguntas.pergunta: Two things are wrong with the room. Which template did he hang the first one on?
perguntas.es: Two things are wrong with the room. Which template did he hang the first one on?
opcoes: 'No hay…' + the thing
'¿Lleva…?' + the thing
The thing + 'no funciona'
'Me han robado' + the thing
perguntas.explica: 'El aire acondicionado no funciona.' Hang anything on it — la ducha, la llave, el ascensor. And when it isn't a machine at all, you switch to 'no hay': no hay agua caliente.
perguntas.pt: 'El aire acondicionado no funciona.' Hang anything on it — la ducha, la llave, el ascensor. And when it isn't a machine at all, you switch to 'no hay': no hay agua caliente.

perguntas.pergunta: At the counter he turns down the extra insurance. What's the very next thing he asks for?
perguntas.es: At the counter he turns down the extra insurance. What's the very next thing he asks for?
opcoes: A different car
A discount on the rental
To speak to the manager in English
The refusal in writing — '¿Me lo puede dar por escrito?'
perguntas.explica: The first refusal usually doesn't work, and the pressure at that counter is verbal by design. 'Por escrito' is the emergency button: almost nobody writes down a claim they can't stand behind.
perguntas.pt: The first refusal usually doesn't work, and the pressure at that counter is verbal by design. 'Por escrito' is the emergency button: almost nobody writes down a claim they can't stand behind.

perguntas.pergunta: 'Le bloqueamos mil doscientos euros en la tarjeta.' What is happening to that money?
perguntas.es: 'Le bloqueamos mil doscientos euros en la tarjeta.' What is happening to that money?
opcoes: It's being charged — it's spent
It's a deposit held on the card, frozen until the car comes back
It's the price of the rental
It's a fine for the low-emission zone
perguntas.explica: Refuse their cover and most companies block a deposit, commonly €500–€1,500 — worse with a debit card or a non-EU card. It's a hold, not a charge, but it's your spending money frozen. Ask how much and when it comes back before he touches the machine.
perguntas.pt: Refuse their cover and most companies block a deposit, commonly €500–€1,500 — worse with a debit card or a non-EU card. It's a hold, not a charge, but it's your spending money frozen. Ask how much and when it comes back before he touches the machine.

perguntas.pergunta: The car has a 'C' sticker and can't enter the centre's ZBE. Your hotel is in the centre. What do you do?
perguntas.es: The car has a 'C' sticker and can't enter the centre's ZBE. Your hotel is in the centre. What do you do?
opcoes: Drive in anyway — hire cars are exempt
Buy a DGT sticker at the petrol station
Park outside the zone and walk in
Drive in, but only after eight in the evening
perguntas.explica: Saw ZBE, don't drive in. Enforcement is an automatic camera, the fine runs up to €200, and the hire company simply passes it on to you — plus an admin fee — months later.
perguntas.pt: Saw ZBE, don't drive in. Enforcement is an automatic camera, the fine runs up to €200, and the hire company simply passes it on to you — plus an admin fee — months later.

opcoes: Petrol — it's the Spanish for 'gasoline'
Diesel
Unleaded 95
Either one; Spanish pumps take both
perguntas.explica: 'Gasóleo' is diesel. Petrol is 'gasolina' — 'gasolina sin plomo', unleaded. The look-alike is a four-figure mistake, so ask at the counter, not at the pump. And 'lleno a lleno' — full to full — is the only fuel policy worth signing.
perguntas.pt: 'Gasóleo' is diesel. Petrol is 'gasolina' — 'gasolina sin plomo', unleaded. The look-alike is a four-figure mistake, so ask at the counter, not at the pump. And 'lleno a lleno' — full to full — is the only fuel policy worth signing.
